name: Submaximal Fatigue Test
desc: The same steady effort every time, then a minute sitting still. Heart rate during the effort and how fast it falls afterwards show how fresh you are. Chest strap on.

cues.text: Chest strap on? This test is all about heart rate.
Three minutes, seated the whole way. Same as last time.
Ten seconds, then stop pedalling and sit still.
Stop pedalling. Stay on the bike, sit still and breathe.
